description: Revalidate and disposition open questions, decisions, and follow-ups surfaced from a Notion Report, Decision, or completed work.

evals.name: Revalidate open questions from a report
evals.prompt: Revalidate the open questions from last week's CSV-export retrospective report.
evals.expected_output: Classifies each item as exactly one of resolved / retained knowledge / Decision needed / actionable work, and does not treat every item as automatically actionable.

evals.name: Disposition follow-ups from a decision
evals.prompt: Disposition the follow-ups from the read-only-mirror design decision.
evals.expected_output: Presents only the actionable-work items as a batch for approval, each with a source anchor, and does not silently create Linear Issues for retained-knowledge or Decision-needed items. Records every item's disposition as its own entry appended to the source record's disposition-history property, not overwriting prior entries.
